Borderline evidence: only 2 runs on each side. A replicate run would make the accept more certain.

Small note: in the start-perturbation branch, maxiter=60 can leave SLSQP unconverged. This is safe as long as the existing repair step still runs after it (the diff does not touch the repair step). The x0 uniform draw is wasted when maximin replaces it, but this is harmless and still deterministic per seed.
Branch probabilities are fine: with a start, about 1/3 jitter, 1/3 swap and 1/3 the existing else-path. Without a start, 50% maximin and 50% uniform.
The candidate mean of about 2.6352 is below the published best of about 2.6360, so it is plausible.
